parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: B1: State $dV/dt=50000-600h$; this may be seen as separate inflow and outflow statements, and when put together in the chain rule B1 can be awarded. M1: Use $V=40000h$ to obtain $dV/dh=40000$ and use this and their $dV/dt$ in the correct chain rule to obtain $dh/dt$, e.g. $dh/dt=(dV/dt)\div(dV/dh)$ and $(50000-600h)/40000=dh/dt$; or obtain $dV/dt=40000\,dh/dt$ and equate to their $dV/dt$, e.g. $40000\,dh/dt=50000-600h$. A1: Obtain $200\,dh/dt=250-3h$ from full and correct working (AG). Special cases: $(50000-600h)/40000=dh/dt$ or equivalent leading to the given answer with no other or incorrect working scores SC B1 (1/3); $dV/dt=50000-600h$ followed by that quotient leading to the given answer scores SC B1 (2/3); $dV/dt=(dV/dh)(dh/dt)$ followed by $50000-600h=40000\,dh/dt$ or equivalent leading to the given answer, with no other or incorrect working, scores B1 for implied $dV/dt$ and SC B1 (2/3). Total 3.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: M1: Separate variables correctly and integrate one side correctly, e.g. $\int\frac1{250-3h}\,dh=\int\frac1{200}\,dt$; integral signs may be omitted and 200 may be on the opposite side. A1: Obtain $-\frac13\ln|250-3h|=\frac t{200}+C$ or equivalent; condone missing $+C$ and lack of modulus signs. M1: Use $t=0,h=50$ in an expression containing $\ln(250-3h)$ or $\ln|250-3h|$ to find the constant, or equivalently use limits 50 and 80. A1: Obtain $C=-\frac13\ln100$ or equivalent, e.g. $\frac13\ln\frac{100}{250-3h}=\frac t{200}$ or $-\frac{200}{3}\ln(10/100)$; with or without modulus signs on log terms. A1: $t=150$. Total 5.
